basics.name: Matt Hays
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Versatile Software Engineer with a solid background in DevOps and data engineering. Skilled in developing scalable solutions and automating workflows using AWS, Python, and Databricks, with a commitment to enhancing efficiency and driving process improvements across teams.

work.name: The Cigna Group
work.summary: Focused on DevOps practices and data engineering, driving improvements in infrastructure and deployment processes.

projects.name: Microservice Modernization
projects.summary: Refactored 12 repositories by addressing technical debt and improving code quality after several years without linting or formatting. I standardized configurations, removed unused functions and variables, and eliminated outdated comments, while also implementing linting and formatting practices. Currently, I’m consolidating the repos into a monorepo in preparation for migration to SaaS GitHub.

projects.name: Custom Terraform Provider
projects.summary: Resolved issues with a buggy API that we were required to use for defining a team's data product by creating a wrapper to better manage permissions and resources. This solution evolved into a Python package and GitHub Action for processing team definitions.

projects.name: Terraform CDK Conversion
projects.summary: Migrated Terraform module definitions to Python to address limitations in logic. This migration allowed selective deployment of expensive Databricks jobs, reducing costs and streamlining CI pipelines. Leveraging Terraform's CDK for Python enabled the creation of abstract base models with smart defaults and simplified configuration using type hints.

projects.name: GitHub Action Automation
projects.summary: Created reusable organizational GitHub Actions and workflows to improve efficiency, including AI-driven PR descriptions using a RAG template, a ServiceNow API for managing release tickets, and compliance code scanning workflows, enabling streamlined processes and reducing duplication in development tasks.

projects.name: PySpark File Ingestion
projects.summary: Developed a PySpark ETL job in Databricks to process files transferred from NAS to S3, organizing disordered file paths and inconsistent naming conventions while aggregating contents.

projects.name: CloudBees Jenkins Optimization
projects.summary: Converted Jenkinsfile and Groovy scripts to pure Python to create a more testable script runner. This was necessary due to resource limitations in CloudBees Jenkins, which often resulted in testing pipelines exceeding an hour. The conversion enabled us to scale horizontally across five CloudBees instances, improving efficiency and reducing testing time.

projects.name: Microservice Development and DevOps
projects.summary: Developed a Flask API and managed CI/CD pipelines for efficient deployment, including implementing logic for blue-green deployments to minimize downtime. Additionally, implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) using LDAP as an authentication server
